items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I was taking a couple of lessons from the old man Shalini.

ctx.x: That was on the clarinet, did you say?

On the clarinet, yeah. And after I left Dave Poikins, I went to Pinchback T-Roll. I was taking a couple of lessons from the old man Shalini. I was taking a couple of lessons from Edmund Hall. I was taking a couple of lessons from T-Roll. Tio, you remember Tio? Yeah, I didn't know him.
